text:
PARIS — French President Emmanuel Macron will host former U.S. Vice President Kamala Harris at the Elysée Palace on Friday, according to his office.
Macron is meeting Harris in “a private capacity for a brief courtesy meeting in the presence of her husband, as he sometimes does at the request of certain former leaders,” the Elysée said in a statement.
The face-to-face comes shortly after the Democrats’ emphatic victory in U.S. midterm elections and as strains grow between Paris and Washington over peace talks on the war in Ukraine. Macron and U.S. President Donald Trump, who defeated Harris in the 2024 presidential election, have had a hot-and-cold relationship in recent years.
Harris is reportedly keeping the door open to running for president again in 2028.
